array.string: lease_root=/tmp/video-production-mounts-501; [[ -d "$lease_root" ]] || exit 0; /usr/bin/find "$lease_root" -type f -name lease.json -mmin +20 -print | while IFS= read -r lease; do session=${lease%/lease.json}; case "$session" in "$lease_root"/*/*) /bin/rm -rf -- "$session";; esac; done
